blessings.name: Celestial Annihilation
blessings.effect: When a character defeats an enemy, their action is Advanced by 100% and they gain 4 stacks of Critical Boost.
blessings.enhancedEffect: When a character defeats an enemy or breaks their Weakness, their action is Advanced by 100% and they gain 4 stacks of Critical Boost.
blessings.source: Official HoYoverse Reference / Verified Game Data

blessings.name: Macrosegregation
blessings.effect: When a character gains a Shield, gains a stack of Special Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 30% of the character's Max HP.
blessings.enhancedEffect: When a character gains a Shield, gains a stack of Special Shield that can absorb DMG equal to 35% of Max HP, stackable up to 3 times.
blessings.source: Official HoYoverse Reference / Verified Game Data

blessings.name: Perfect Experience: Fuli
blessings.effect: When hitting a Frozen enemy, there is a 100% base chance to inflict Dissociation on them for 1 turn. Dissociation deals 30% of target Max HP as True DMG upon removal.
blessings.enhancedEffect: When hitting a Frozen enemy, there is a 100% base chance to inflict Dissociation for 1 turn, and Dissociation deals 40% Max HP True DMG.
blessings.source: Official HoYoverse Reference / Verified Game Data

equations.name: Silent Singer
equations.effect: When an ally deals DMG to a debuffed enemy, increases all allies' ATK by 25% and regenerates 3 Energy.
equations.source: Official HoYoverse Reference / Verified Game Data

equations.name: Voyage Monitor
equations.effect: When an ally gains a Shield, there is a 75% base chance to inflict Freeze on all enemies for 1 turn and increases Shield strength by 30%.
equations.source: Official HoYoverse Reference / Verified Game Data

curios.name: Interastral Peace Special Curio
curios.effect: Obtains 150 Cosmic Fragments immediately. All shop items in Divergent Universe cost 20% fewer Cosmic Fragments.
curios.source: Official HoYoverse Reference / Verified Game Data

curios.name: Rubert Difference Engine
curios.effect: Upon entering battle, all characters obtain 100% Ultimate Energy. Increases all allies' Ultimate DMG by 50%.
curios.source: Official HoYoverse Reference / Verified Game Data
